title: Day 16: How to Price Your Home to Sell in the 2026 Austin Market
excerpt: Sellers searching these terms want a realistic number, not an aspirational one.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “how to price my house Austin”, “what is my home worth Austin TX”, and “CMA Austin real estate” want a local, practical answer.

Sellers searching these terms want a realistic number, not an aspirational one. In a market with 4–6 months of inventory in many segments, pricing to the last 60–90 days of closed comps (adjusted for condition and features) produces the strongest results.

Overpricing by even 5% often lengthens days on market and ultimately lowers the final sale price.

Price-band psychology still matters: $499k vs $505k, $699k vs $715k changes the buyer pool that sees the listing online.

A professional comparative market analysis remains the foundation; online estimates are starting points only.
